authentication: Normal Cognito Authorization Code + PKCE; each run revoked its own session (HTTP 204)

compatibilityRelease.note: Refusal-only: every PATCH body used current values and was refused before any write; legacy settings and the event catalogue re-read unchanged. A first invocation with a malformed SHA argument stopped in preflight before signing in.

checks.noOverrideInvented: all four keys remain default-sourced at stored version 0, as staging had no legacy override for them

readerRelease.note: Read-only. Also carries the access-log format fix (2bfae89).

accessLogFormat.firstFormat: ac84907, released with ec6fc8e: every line without an error ended in "errorMessage":- and did not parse as JSON (58 of 58 sampled lines).
accessLogFormat.fixed: 2bfae89: all 37 lines written during the reader acceptance parse as JSON; the device read logged status 200 with integrationStatus 200.

ordering: The reader release was pushed only after the compatibility image was the single running task, so no instance wrote the four keys to the legacy store after the copy.
limitations: lostPersonPurgeHours needs a guarded privacy writer; eventName and the four platform-only keys remain legacy. A catalogue change reaches a device on its next page load. AppSetting is not dropped. P10.8 and G3 remain open.
